text: Right, I've been sat on hold earlier and then told to text so here I am. I'm looking after my nephew Callum who's 11, his mum's on a night shift. He's got the chickenpox, came out in spots yesterday, and they're itchy as anything, he's been girning about them all evening. Took his temperature about half an hour ago and it was 38.3. Apart from that he's grand, honestly, he's been eating crisps and moaning at the telly like usual. His colour's fine and his lips are normal, no bother there. The thing his mum's worried about is he's also got a load of red spots on his arms and the backs of his legs that aren't the pox, they're just midgie and mosquito bites from being out in the garden all day yesterday with his pals, he was eaten alive, you can see the wee bite marks in the middle and they're all lumpy like bites always are. So that's no a new thing, just the bites. I just want to know what I can give him for the temperature and the itching that's safe with the chickenpox, because I've heard you're no supposed to give some things. I'd appreciate a reply sometime the night if that's no too much to ask.
